name: Hana Hiraku ~Ano Ko wa AV Jou~
source:
Main character learns to be movie director after his father who is legendary AV director. Protagonist struggles with the funding of his independent films, so decides to shoot some AV movies to sell quickly thanks to his father's fame.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-january-2003-moekan.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公追随父亲脚步，学习成为电影导演。父亲是一名传说级成人影片导演。主人公为独立电影的资金问题苦苦挣扎，于是决定借助父亲的名声拍摄几部成人影片，迅速出售筹集资金。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-january-2003-moekan.html]vndbreview[/url]]
